name: xue-mint
description: Private photo backup: local server, web gallery and shared UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run build -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run dev -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run test -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run lint -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @xue-mint/shared && npm run typecheck -w @xue-mint/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
